title: Teramoto 2013 Experiment 2 · hand and sound location
citation: Teramoto, W., Nozoe, S., & Sekiyama, K. (2013). Audiotactile interactions beyond the space and body parts around the head. Experimental Brain Research, 228(4), 427–436.
notes: The auditory inspection covers only the near-head subset of the nominal condition grid. The published blocks, knee-side speakers and pneumatic apparatus require separate qualification.

apparatus.posture: Seated and blindfolded in a sound-attenuated room.

far_sound.description: Fixed loudspeaker positions just to either side of the knees.

apparatus.sound: Stationary white-noise distractor, 50 ms, 90 dBA at ear position.
apparatus.headphone_masker: Continuous white noise, 68 dBA, to mask pneumatic operation.
apparatus.audibility_check: Sample trials confirmed the noise distractor remained audible and stimulator operation was masked.

tactile.study_timing: The study compensated the reported trigger-to-outlet delay to align intended sound and air-puff onsets.

response.task: Respond quickly and accurately to the air-puff side while ignoring the auditory distractor.

analysis.inverse_efficiency: Median correct RT divided by proportion correct in each condition.
analysis.interference: Opposite-side minus same-side inverse efficiency. Exclude incorrect trials from RT analysis.

inspection_scope.auditory_spatialization: Toolkit stereo pan; rear placement is reported apparatus geometry.
inspection_scope.details: One pass over 16 near-head cells uses the reported near speaker geometry and annotations for hand posture, surface and target side. Exact within-block quotas remain unreported. The 16 nominal knee-side cells remain in the published condition matrix, with geometry unresolved.

implementation_gaps: The synchronized scheduler requires independently addressed pneumatic outputs, a calibrated air-puff trigger-to-skin delay, and matching loudspeaker trigger-to-ear timing. This inspection emits no tactile output.
The calibrated speaker and headphone masker channels and delivered levels must be measured. The original sound waveforms, exact headphone model and installed calibration are unavailable.
Two footpedals and correctness scoring are required for response capture. Foreperiod and response deadline settings are unreported.
The scheduler requires eight blocks selected by hand surface, hand position and sound position. The source omits exact knee-side speaker coordinates and within-block side quotas.

provenance.field: Condition blocking, cue delivery, side responses and practice
provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1007/s00221-013-3574-5, pp. 431–433, Experiment 2 Stimuli and procedure, Results, Fig. 2 and Table 2.

provenance.field: Pneumatic latency compensation, near speaker placement and masking
provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1007/s00221-013-3574-5, p. 429, Experiment 1 Apparatus and Procedure as referenced in Experiment 2.
